items.title: Re-vendor LibKa0s v1.71.0 from the local tag; record the unrecorded v1.69.0/v1.70.0 re-vendors in one span bundle
items.spec: Mechanical re-vendor per the dev-copilot:wow-revendor-libka0s convention, no adoption interview, no GitHub issue filing (OWNER_SCOPE 5). (1) Payloads: `libs/LibKa0s/` replaced whole by the v1.71.0 tag's `LibKa0s/` tree and `tests/_kit/` replaced whole by its `testkit/` tree (read from the LOCAL tag in ../LibKa0s, e.g. `git -C ../LibKa0s archive v1.71.0 LibKa0s testkit` into a scratch dir, then copy; never from the working tree). (2) CLAUDE.md provenance line becomes exactly `Bundles [LibKa0s](https://github.com/tusharsaxena/LibKa0s) v1.71.0 (MIT).` in the same commit (tests/test_vendor_sync.lua greps it). docs/ARCHITECTURE.md ## External dependencies `v1.70.0` -> `v1.71.0` (only the version token; the rest of that paragraph is PC-06's). (3) Kit revision 38 changes the --list Totals semantics (LK-01): regenerate docs/test-cases.md in the same commit; the one declared skip moves to a `| Skipped | 1 |` row and Total now reads 572, equal to the README badge 572/572 (resolves PC-R-07; if the badge count has moved since, Total must equal it). (4) Span bundle for the two re-vendors that left no record (commits 136cf54 v1.69.0 and 7a1aabf v1.70.0): docs/revendor/2026-10-07-v1.69.0-v1.70.0/ with 01_DELTA.md whose line 1 is exactly `Delta: LibKa0s v1.69.0 -> v1.70.0 (span: v1.69.0 v1.70.0)`; the body names base v1.68.1 (bundle 2026-10-04-v1.68.1), both commits, WidgetsLineChart.lua (new at v1.69.0), WidgetsAutocomplete.lua and kit 37's mock_lines.lua; 05_SUMMARY.md has one line per tag: carried by the sweep, nothing adopted; Widgets declined (#11). Match the file set of 2026-10-01-v1.64.0-v1.65.0 (01_DELTA, 02_CANDIDATES, 03_DECISIONS, 05_SUMMARY). (5) Release bundle docs/revendor/2026-10-07-v1.71.0/ (01_DELTA.md line 1 `Delta: LibKa0s v1.70.0 -> v1.71.0`; per-file LibStub minors; kit 37 -> 38 pairing; majors this addon consumes (Core, Env, Media, DebugLog, Slash, Options, Launcher, Lifecycle, Schema): Env minor 2 and OptionsIdList minor 4 drop dead rungs, Slash key 20.2 ParseValue refuses nan/inf, no contract change under an unmoved signature; 02_CANDIDATES/03_DECISIONS list Kit.secret (LK-02), the WidgetsLineChart/WidgetsAutocomplete fixes (LK-03/LK-04, Widgets declined #11) as `not adopted in this run`; 05_SUMMARY.md states the Totals fix closes PC-R-07). (6) Any red the fresh payload causes is fixed in this commit only if it is a mechanical consequence of the copy (e.g. a test asserting the old Totals shape or the old provenance string); a behaviour red stops and is flagged. No change to authored addon code beyond that.
items.steps:
1. `git -C ../LibKa0s tag -l v1.71.0` exists (local); stage the tag's LibKa0s/ and testkit/ in the scratchpad.
2. `rm -rf libs/LibKa0s tests/_kit` then copy both whole; restore CRLF per .gitattributes (git add --renormalize if needed).
3. Roll the CLAUDE.md provenance line and the ARCHITECTURE.md version token.
4. `lua tests/run.lua`; fix only mechanical copy consequences; regenerate docs/test-cases.md; confirm Total == badge.
5. Write docs/revendor/2026-10-07-v1.69.0-v1.70.0/ (from `git show 136cf54 --stat`, `git show 7a1aabf --stat`) and docs/revendor/2026-10-07-v1.71.0/.
6. Green gate; commit `RV-PC: re-vendor LibKa0s v1.71.0 (kit 38); record the v1.69.0/v1.70.0 span`.

items.title: Schema refuses an empty or whitespace-only format, so the panel can no longer store a blank chat string
items.spec: settings/Schema.lua refusedBySignature(row, value) (:342) gains a first rule for format rows: a value that is a string and matches `^%s*$` is refused with a localized reason from a new locales/enUS.lua key, e.g. L["A format can't be blank. Use Reset to restore the default."] (add it to every locale file the repo keeps per the locales rule, enUS as the source). Because Schema.Set (:362) and the default self-check (:1026) both route through refusedBySignature, the settings panel path (settings/Panel.lua:274-277, Enter on a cleared New box -> Schema.Set(path, "")) is refused and the previous stored value is kept; the panel shows the refusal the same way it shows a signature refusal today. /pc set's existing blank refusal (settings/Slash.lua:270-272) stays; if it can now defer to the schema's message without changing its output, leave it untouched (no scope creep). No shipped default is blank, so the load-time default check stays green.
items.steps:
1. Red: tests/test_schema.lua cases: Schema.Set('<a real format path>', '') returns refused with the new message and leaves the stored value unchanged; same for '   ' and '\t'; a non-blank valid format still sets. Add a tests/test_panel.lua case that drives the New box's Enter handler with '' and asserts db.profile is unchanged. Add `-- red under:` notes. Run and see red.
2. Implement the rule and the locale key.
3. Regenerate the inventory (`lua tests/run.lua --list > docs/test-cases.md`) and move the README `Tests` badge to the new Total in the SAME commit (docs/testing.md:216).
4. Green gate; commit `PC-01: refuse blank formats in the schema (panel stored "")`.

items.title: RunMigrations leaves a newer build's data alone: no prune and no restamp when the stored schemaVersion is ahead
items.spec: core/Database.lua RunMigrations (:194-204): when `db.global.schemaVersion` is a number greater than Database.SCHEMA_VERSION, emit one NS.Debug("Migrate", "stored schema v%d is newer than this build's v%d; leaving the profile untouched", ...) and return before runSteps, the restamp and PruneOrphans, so strings[G]/disabledStrings[G] written by a newer build survive a rollback and the stamp stays. Rewrite the header comment (:189-193) to state the new rule (ahead = written by a newer build, left untouched) instead of 'normalized down'. Behaviour for stamps <= SCHEMA_VERSION is unchanged.
items.steps:
1. Red: deliberately rewrite tests/test_database.lua:61-65 ('the runner stamps the current version...') so an ahead stamp (SCHEMA_VERSION + 5) is asserted UNCHANGED; add a case with schemaVersion 99 plus a stored override under a global with no schema row in this build, asserting it survives RunMigrations and the debug line is emitted once. `-- red under:` notes. See red.
2. Implement the early return; update the header comment.
3. Regenerate the inventory (`lua tests/run.lua --list > docs/test-cases.md`) and move the README `Tests` badge to the new Total in the SAME commit (docs/testing.md:216).
4. Green gate; commit `PC-02: do not prune or restamp a profile written by a newer build`.

items.title: Categories page header Defaults asks before resetting all eight tabs; the footer path (already confirmed by Blizzard) does not ask twice
items.spec: Decision taken (owner delegated): do it, header path only. settings/Panel.lua: new StaticPopupDialogs["PRETTYCHAT_RESET_CATEGORIES"] next to PRETTYCHAT_RESET_ALL (:43), text from a new locale key, e.g. L["Reset the strings on every category tab to their defaults? Your edits in every category are discarded."], button1 YES, button2 NO, timeout 0, whileDead, hideOnEscape, OnAccept = PrettyChat:ResetCategoriesPage(). New PrettyChat:ConfirmResetCategories() shows it. The library routes BOTH the header button (libs/LibKa0s/Options.lua:792-797, called as onClick(widget, ...)) and the footer forwarder (Options.lua:681-685, called as defaultsOnClick() with no args) through panel.defaultsOnClick, so the Categories handler (:756-758) distinguishes them by argument count: `function(...) if select('#', ...) > 0 then PrettyChat:ConfirmResetCategories() else PrettyChat:ResetCategoriesPage() end end`, with a comment explaining that the footer path has already been confirmed by Blizzard's own Defaults dialog. Combat refusal stays in the library on both paths. The General page is not changed. README.md:63/:65 wording says the Categories Defaults button asks first; docs/settings-panel.md if it describes the button.

items.title: Comment and doc truth: _G writes do taint (only non-protected readers), and the report-size and addon-count figures stop contradicting each other
items.spec: Comment/doc only, no code change. (1) docs/data-flow.md:141: replace "`ApplyStrings` is unprotected; `_G` writes don't taint." with: the writes DO taint the overridden globals (issecurevariable answers false, "PrettyChat"), but only non-protected chat formatting reads them, so no protected path is affected and the pipeline needs no combat guard; note it is unverified against the current client and is an owner in-client observation, not a gate. (3) settings/Schema.lua:104-105: 'nine addons drawing the same tab from nine hand-written copies' becomes count-free ('every addon drawing the same tab from its own hand-written copy').
